method: Frozen default camera, clean cloth. GPU-filtered sRGB scan at identical visible UVs; silhouette eroded 2px. Circular saturation-weighted mean hue, mean HSV saturation, mean Rec.709 sRGB luminance. Any channel =255 counts as clipping.
